highlights: 修复 #62：muse.ai 从 2026-11-19 起聊天里只显示约 498px 的缩略图，生成的图片因此变小。现在图片任务会打开 muse.ai 的图片查看器取原图（实测 1344x1792），取不到时仍返回缩略图并在日志里提示。
只影响图片任务；视频、对话与参考素材上传不变。无需升级浏览器插件。
浏览器插件同步升级至 1.0.3；请下载新包替换原扩展目录文件，再到 chrome://extensions 或 edge://extensions 手动重新加载，每个浏览器个人资料分别操作。
本分支新增：参考图生图「纯净画面/去水印」提示词自动注入可在管理页面「接口测试 → 生图提示词增强」中随时开关；默认关闭，提示词完全由调用方传入（可用 MUSE2API_IMAGE_PROMPT_CLEANUP_INJECT 修改默认值）。
highlights_en: Fix #62: since 2026-11-19 muse.ai shows only a ~498px thumbnail in the chat, so generated images came back small. Image tasks now open muse.ai's image viewer and return the full-size picture (measured 1344x1792); if it cannot be opened the thumbnail is still returned and a warning is logged.
Images only; video, chat and reference uploads are unchanged. No extension upgrade is needed.

Browser extension updated to 1.0.3. Download the new package, replace the files in the original extension folder, then manually reload at chrome://extensions or edge://extensions in every browser profile.

Fork addition: the automatic 'clean image / remove watermark' prompt for reference-image generation can be toggled at Admin → API Test → Image prompt enhancement. Off by default, so the prompt is passed through exactly as supplied by the caller (default configurable via MUSE2API_IMAGE_PROMPT_CLEANUP_INJECT).
